baseline_models.focus_anchor: أُوتِيتُم ... مَتَاعُ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا / مَا عِندَ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰ
baseline_models.mechanism: The received side is genuine utility and need-serving provision, but it belongs to the near life and has limited tenure; the contrasting side is beneficial good present with God and characterized by persistence.

activation_trace.role: Giving and delivery make the earthly side an allotment received rather than self-secured property.
Need-serving goods supply the useful, portable character of the worldly allotment.
The near or first sphere supplies temporal immediacy without requiring that its utility be denied.
Presence and proximity locate the superior good in God's keeping.
Beneficial good supplies the qualitative, not merely quantitative, superiority.
Persistence against passing away supplies the decisive tenure contrast.

changed_reading.before: Earthly goods are dismissed because material usefulness is itself bad.
changed_reading.after: Earthly goods are useful received provision, but their near-term tenure ranks below beneficial good held with God that persists.

baseline_models.mechanism: Heart-settled trust transfers ultimate management to a Lord whose rule includes ownership, gradual nurture, and sufficient guardianship; this is a relocation of reliance, not praise of incapacity.

activation_trace.role: Security and trust in the heart supply the settled posture from which reliance proceeds.
Heart-assured assent keeps the posture epistemic and relational, not merely emotional.
Ownership and lordship identify the one to whom final control is assigned.
Incremental repair and nurture make the relied-on rule an ongoing care process.
Reliance supplies the act of resting the affair on another.
Sufficient guardianship supplies the positive competence of the relied-on keeper.

changed_reading.before: Trust means passive resignation after renouncing worldly means.
changed_reading.after: Trust means using provisional means while relocating ultimate management to the nurturing and sufficient Lord.

baseline_models.mechanism: A form-distant but live branch contrast reads worldly life as an interval in which one is kept and given delay for enjoyment, while the divine side evokes both durable remainder and merciful preservation.

activation_trace.role: Being kept and granted delay for enjoyment supplies a finite tenure model for worldly life.
Continuance against extinction supplies the stronger mode of keeping.
Sparing through pardon or mercy lets endurance include preserved relation, not only long-lived objects.
Sustaining care links preservation to the Lord on whom the named group relies.

changed_reading.before: More enduring means only that later possessions last longer.
changed_reading.after: The verse can contrast a granted interval of use with a deeper preservation in which good, person, and relation are kept from loss.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly treats provision as controlled expansion, constriction, measured descent, and rain-like release; the explicit risk that unbounded expansion produces transgression changes worldly receipt from a neutral pile into calibrated flow.

activation_trace.role: Spreading and extension supply the expansion pole of provision.
Constriction to a limited measure supplies the contraction pole paired with expansion.
An apportioned gift identifies the object being expanded or measured.
Transgressing a limit supplies the moral overload that follows unrestricted expansion in the sequence.
Delivery downward makes provision a released flow rather than an autonomous stock.
A bounded amount supplies the regulator on that release.
Life-giving rain supplies the material image of beneficial release after withholding.
Rain reviving dry pasture supplies the flourishing enabled by measured release.
Need-serving worldly provision remains the focus object reclassified by this flow model.

structural_cues: 42:12 pairs expansion and constriction; 42:27 makes unrestricted expansion precede transgression and measured descent; 42:28 follows with rain after despair and mercy spreading.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the paired controls and the local sequences; I infer that restriction can function as care and abundance as moral load. A live alternative is that these are separate sovereignty examples rather than one regulatory mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Whatever one receives is a static quantity whose increase is straightforwardly better.
changed_reading.after: Worldly provision is a metered release whose expansion and restriction may regulate moral and ecological flourishing, so trust does not equate more with better.

context_deltas.mechanism: The doubled harvest construction makes desire an orientation of cultivation: one harvest grows, while the worldly harvest yields only a current receipt and no later allotted share; the following promise of what is desired at the Lord supplies the durable counterpart.

activation_trace.role: Will and desire supply the directing intention for each of the two harvests.
Sowing and cultivation turn present effort and goods into inputs ordered toward a yield.
Growth supplies the compounding result of the afterlife-oriented harvest.
A current giving supplies the bounded payout of the worldly harvest.
An assigned share supplies the later allocation that the worldly-only harvest lacks.
Presence with the Lord gives relational location to the desired durable yield.
Surplus and remainder supply a yield exceeding bare equivalence.
Current need-serving provision becomes possible cultivation input rather than merely a rival store.

structural_cues: 42:20 repeats desire and harvest in a balanced contrast, then distinguishes increase, present receipt, and absent later share; 42:22 places desired good at the Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies agricultural parallelism and contrasting yields; I infer that present goods can be directed as cultivation inputs. A live alternative is that 'harvest' names desired outcomes without implying conversion of the current allotment.

changed_reading.before: The verse compares two sealed stores, one worldly and one later.
changed_reading.after: The present allotment can be oriented as cultivation: worldly-only desire cashes out now, while another orientation produces increase and a share located with the Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus calls worldly life the near sphere, but the surah has already called the Hour near; immediacy therefore cannot belong exclusively to worldly visibility, and endurance rather than psychological distance carries the ranking.

activation_trace.role: Temporal approach and impending completion make the Hour itself near.
The near or first life repeats the same proximity field in the harvest contrast.
Worldly nearness remains the focus anchor whose monopoly on immediacy is displaced.
Persistence supplies the criterion that distinguishes two things both presented as near.

structural_cues: 42:17 says the Hour may be near; 42:20 and 42:36 repeatedly mark worldly life as the near sphere.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two proximity statements; I infer that their echo counters temporal discounting. A live alternative is that the Hour's nearness is warning language with no intended lexical dialogue with الدنيا.

changed_reading.before: Trust chooses a remote speculative future over the only reality that is near.
changed_reading.after: Worldly life is near, but the Hour is also near; the choice is between competing proximities ranked by persistence, not between present fact and remote abstraction.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, ships move on a wide sea, external wind can be stilled, moving vessels become fixed, destruction can overtake them, and no evasive route remains; tawakkul becomes shipboard agency under a motive force and survival margin the traveler does not own.

activation_trace.role: Flowing movement supplies the vessel's effective travel and use.
Loss of motion supplies the external interruption of that effective use.
Wind and moving air supply the vessel's unowned motive condition.
Fixity after motion supplies the visible result when that condition is withdrawn.
Being brought into destruction supplies the vessel and cargo's exposure to loss.
No deviation to an escape route closes the illusion of autonomous control.
Useful portable goods include, by inference, the cargo and means whose usability depends on the voyage.
Reliance names the posture suited to acting amid conditions one cannot command.

structural_cues: 42:32-35 is the uninterrupted scene immediately preceding 42:36: moving ships, stilled wind, stationary hulls, possible destruction or pardon, and no escape.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies motion, wind, arrest, destruction, and no escape; I infer the ship as a material model for the focus relation between usable means and reliance. A live alternative is that the scene demonstrates power without specifying a trust practice.

changed_reading.before: Trust is inward calm largely unrelated to competent use of material means.
changed_reading.after: Trust is shipboard action: one boards, carries, and navigates, while recognizing that motive force, continued movement, and survival are not possessions.

context_deltas.mechanism: The coordinated post-focus profile joins forgiveness under anger, collective extraction of judgment, outward flow of provision, and self-defense to the same believing group; trust is thus socially distributed agency with controlled rather than absent power.

activation_trace.role: Covering the offense and protecting from its effect supplies power restrained under anger.
The shared affair supplies the practical object of collective governance.
Extracting judgment through reciprocal review supplies distributed decision-making.
The outward passage of wealth supplies circulation of what was provisioned.
Vindication of the wronged supplies active resistance rather than helpless dependence.
Believing assent anchors the same named profile in the focus.
Reliance is the focus posture now shown alongside deliberation, expenditure, and defense.

structural_cues: 42:36 begins a profile with للذين; 42:37-39 continue it through coordinated والذين clauses covering anger, response to the Lord, prayer, council, spending, and response to aggression.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a grammatically coordinated profile; I infer coexistence and mutual qualification, not that trust mechanically causes every later trait. A live alternative is to read the clauses as a list without a functional agency model.

changed_reading.before: Those who rely withdraw from planning, resource allocation, and resistance.
changed_reading.after: The relying group deliberates, circulates provision, restrains anger, and can defend itself; entrusted dependence and organized agency coexist.

context_deltas.mechanism: The text preserves a wronged person's right to vindication and exact equivalence, then offers pardon plus repair with compensation resting on God; trust can deliberately exchange an immediately realizable claim for a God-held return without redefining powerlessness as virtue.

activation_trace.role: Vindication of the wronged establishes that a realizable defensive claim exists.
Act-for-act recompense supplies the settlement frame.
Equivalence supplies the permitted immediate valuation of the injury.
Leaving punishment and erasing fault relinquish collection of that immediate equivalent.
Removing social estrangement makes the relinquishment reparative rather than evasive.
Compensation for action supplies the return now assigned to God.
Holding the self against panic supplies the temporal capacity to defer collection.
A heart firmly resolved supplies deliberate choice rather than weakness.
Good present with God supplies the focus-side location of the deferred return.
Entrusting the affair supplies the transfer of final settlement to God.

structural_cues: 42:39-42 validates defense and exact response while restricting blame to aggressors; 42:40 and 42:43 distinguish pardon with repair and resolute patience from incapacity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a valid immediate equivalent and a pardoning alternative whose reward is on God; I infer an exchange from present collection to divine settlement. A live alternative is moral commendation without any account-like transfer mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Trust requires surrendering a right because the believer cannot act.
changed_reading.after: Trust can preserve the right to resist yet deliberately move collection from an immediate equivalent to a return resting with God, when pardon also repairs.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later mercy is tasted rather than owned, pleasure can swell into exultation, adversity exposes concealment of benefit, and divine gifts include divergent child configurations as well as infertility; 'whatever you are given' broadens from wealth to temporary, nonfungible life allotments that disclose orientation.

activation_trace.role: Experiencing and being tried by a thing make mercy an exposure that tests the recipient.
Exultant delight supplies one unstable reaction to favorable experience.
Covering over benefit supplies the adverse reaction that the trial reveals.
A gift without exchange broadens receipt beyond earned or priced commodities.
Infertility supplies a life configuration that cannot be reduced to more or less fungible wealth.
The focus's unrestricted giving construction is the anchor whose scope is expanded.
The general knowable thing prevents the focus allotment from narrowing to money.
Experienced benefit supplies what remains temporary across very different gift forms.

structural_cues: 42:48 contrasts tasted mercy and adversity through unstable human reactions; 42:49-50 immediately enumerate daughters, sons, both, and infertility as willed gift configurations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the taste/test vocabulary and a gift taxonomy; I infer that this later sequence expands the focus's indefinite 'whatever.' A live alternative is that the gift taxonomy is a separate creation argument rather than a specification of worldly allotment.

changed_reading.before: Whatever is given primarily means a measurable stock of wealth.
changed_reading.after: It includes unpriced and mutually incommensurable life allotments; each is temporarily experienced and can reveal whether the recipient rests in the gift or in its giver.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links the focus's worldly utility to a later ع ر ض wordplay: the surface in 42:45 most directly means being presented, while packet branches also carry transient occurrence and worldly chattel. It remains anchored to مَتَاعُ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا through that shared transience-and-goods field, but downstream prose should present it only as a reversible gaze image, not as the lexical gloss of يُعْرَضُونَ.

activation_trace.role: Useful goods supply the apparent object controlled by the worldly possessor.
The near worldly sphere supplies the setting of that possession relation.
Presentation for inspection reverses the gaze so former possessors become displayed objects.
A transient occurrence contributes the passing status shared with worldly utility.
Worldly chattel and temporary lot make the branch-level bridge back to the focus's goods.

changed_reading.before: The worldly subject securely surveys and possesses temporary objects.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, attachment to transient goods ends in a reversal: the possessor becomes the exposed object, looking only from a furtive edge.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it expands 'what is with God' from deferred recompense to nonmaterial guidance transmitted from a hidden source. It remains anchored to مَا عِندَ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰ and to the surah's closing spirit-light-path sequence, but the focus does not explicitly identify its enduring good with revelation; downstream prose should qualify this as an expansion of source custody, not a replacement interpretation.

activation_trace.role: Presence with God supplies source custody rather than necessary non-delivery.
Persistence supplies the criterion by which source-held good differs from consumed utility.
Knowledge cast through hidden transmission supplies a nonmaterial mode of divine giving.
A screening barrier supplies hidden source separation without absence of communication.
Messenger and message supply a delegated delivery channel.
Life-giving spirit supplies the noncommodity content delivered from the divine command.
Illumination supplies the durable orienting effect of that delivery.
Gentle direction to the path supplies the functional yield of the source-held good.

changed_reading.before: What is with God is only a remote warehouse of later material compensation.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, divine custody can also name a hidden source that delivers spirit, light, and orientation without becoming a consumable possession.

strongest_changes: Provision became calibrated release and cultivable input rather than a static pile; expansion can overload moral limits while another orientation compounds yield.
The immediately preceding ship sequence made tawakkul a practice of competent movement under motive force and survival conditions the traveler cannot own.
The coordinated post-focus profile joined trust to consultation, spending, defense, and deliberate pardon that can move recompense from immediate collection to God.
Calling the Hour near prevented worldly nearness from monopolizing what counts as present realism.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet exposed a tight material-social mechanism around 42:36: measured rain and provision, dual harvests, ships arrested when wind is withdrawn, then a coordinated community that governs, spends, resists, and sometimes defers settlement to God. Later taste and gift language also widened 'whatever you are given' beyond wealth.
remaining_uncertainties: The regulatory reading of expansion, restriction, and rain may be a productive analogy rather than one intended causal system.
The echo between the near Hour and the near life may counter temporal discounting, or it may be only lexical recurrence.
The two outliers depend on branch-level cross-domain activation and should remain explicitly exploratory.
